basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old software developer living in Astoria, New York. I have a deep-seated love for sitcoms, especially 'New Girl', and often find myself rewatching episodes in my downtime. I also have a passion for indie music and frequently attend live shows around the city. When I'm not coding or watching TV, I'm exploring new recipes in my kitchen. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it affords me to dive deep into my hobbies, whether it's late-night coding sessions or impromptu weekend trips. I generally browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 15 years. My expertise lies in web development, particularly in JavaScript and Python. Much of my knowledge is self-taught through online courses and forums, which is why I frequent subreddits related to technology and programming.
